Interface IuJsonArrayAdapter<T,E>

Type Parameters:
T - container type
E - item type; boxed for a primitive array
All Superinterfaces:
IuJsonAdapter<T>
All Known Implementing Classes:
ArrayAdapter, CollectionAdapter, EnumerationAdapter, IterableAdapter, IteratorAdapter, JsonArrayAdapter, PrimitiveArrayAdapter, StreamAdapter
public interface IuJsonArrayAdapter<T,E> extends IuJsonAdapter<T>
A conversion for a type whose values convert to and from a JSON array: arrays, including primitive arrays, and the iterable, collection, iterator, enumeration, and stream types IuJsonAdapter.of(Type) supports.

Beyond converting, it takes the items out of a value and puts items into a new one, for code that reads or writes the items itself, such as accepting a single value where an array is expected, as in a JsonbDeserializer whose items convert as the JSON-B call does: 

IuJsonArrayAdapter.of(type).collect(List.of(item))

  • Method Details

    • of

      static <T,E> IuJsonArrayAdapter<T,E> of(Type type)
      Gets the built-in conversion for a type that converts to and from a JSON array.

      Items convert as the JSON-B call in progress on this thread converts them, if any, so a JsonbDeserializer can collect items of any type the JSON-B instance converts; otherwise by the built-in conversions. An adapter got outside a call keeps the built-ins.

      Type Parameters:
      T - container type
      E - item type
      Parameters:
      type - array, iterable, collection, iterator, enumeration, or stream type
      Returns:
      conversion
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if type has a conversion, but not to and from a JSON array
      UnsupportedOperationException - if type, or its item type, has no conversion, as for IuJsonAdapter.of(Type)
      See Also:
      • IuJsonAdapter.of(Type)

    • collect

      T collect(Iterable<E> items)
      Creates a value of the target type holding the given items, in order.
      • A collection, array, or primitive array is a new instance; a collection is mutable, of the class named or the default for the interface named: ArrayList for a list, LinkedHashSet for a set, TreeSet for a sorted set, and ArrayDeque for a collection, queue, or deque.
      • An Iterable target returns items itself, not a copy, so List.of(item) reads as an immutable one-item Iterable.
      • A Stream, Iterator, or Enumeration is a lazy, single-use view over items, which must stay valid until it is consumed.
      Parameters:
      items - items
      Returns:
      value of the target type
